gate_policies.owner_start: Owner explicitly started implementation on 2026-10-21 in the conversation. Execute bounded tickets within approved scope; this manifest does not itself authorize external actions, signing/account changes, provider calls or publishing.
gate_policies.dependency_and_scope: Re-read exact ticket and referenced contracts before activation; require all requires_done outcomes with actual evidence. Reconcile statuses from progress.md and ticket files. Dependency/type/membership/scope changes invalidate the affected ordering; repair the plan before continuing, without reopening unchanged approved decisions.
gate_policies.completion_evidence: One scoped ticket at a time by default. Record actual files/artifacts, relevant checks, sanitized evidence, limitations and required reviewer/owner/device acceptance; synchronize ticket/progress/milestone/feature status. Never mark done from generated output or a command exit alone. Resume interrupted work from verified evidence; no silent duplicate submissions, credits or resets.
gate_policies.group_closure: A delivery group is a closure audit, never one implementation assignment. Require all named dependencies, every required child AND the parent original acceptance criteria; verify compatible versions and outstanding blockers. Child completion alone cannot auto-close the parent. Do not make a child depend on its own parent.
gate_policies.unapproved_choices: Use approved decisions without asking again. Implementer resolves routine engineering choices inside scope; ask only for genuinely unapproved material product choices listed in readiness-review.md. Hold affected work until required answers arrive. Do not silently choose defaults or expand scope.
gate_policies.qualified_review_and_rights: Draft preparation may proceed under approved scope, but required qualified content/rubric/descriptor/rights review must be actual before reviewed publication/pilot or ticket closure. SC-T006 currently blocked: no reviewer. AI/owner product review is not educator review.
gate_policies.real_acceptance: Run the exact applicable acceptance on identified builds/content/devices/providers; fixtures/static docs cannot replace mandatory physical/provider/owner/qualified evidence. Record missing evidence as NOT_RUN/BLOCKED and leave the affected gate open.
gate_policies.live_provider: Provisional local/fixture engineering may proceed after owner development start. Before each applicable real call verify current account terms/native permission, host/model access, allowance/expiry/effective Free Quota Only, disclosure/consent and request scope. No credentials in docs/logs, no automatic paid retry, account change, backend or fallback. Reuse valid evidence; never invent live success.
gate_policies.learner_evidence: Freeze prospective protocol/rubric/support and obtain required consent/review before baseline. Honor actual day-7/day-28 windows and missing evidence; do not sleep/poll continuously, compress time or synthesize results. SC-T043 requires an actual owner/educator expansion decision before SC-T063/026; completion alone cannot authorize expansion. Reuse unchanged valid evidence where allowed.
gate_policies.physical_signing_distribution: Simulator/domain work does not require a separately approved setup-review round. Confirm signing identity and device access before signed installation. Existing scope/owner rules apply to credentials/signing/account changes. No Git initialization, destructive replacement, TestFlight/store publishing or release solely from this queue.

dispatch.priority: Lowest order among eligible queued items; order is preference, requires_done and gates are mandatory
dispatch.eligibility: Owner start/scope permits work; current dependencies actually done; no unresolved gate for that action. A snapshot pending/blocked state is not permission. Partial authorized work can run but cannot close without full acceptance.
dispatch.blocked_item: Record specific blocker and stop its branch. Continue another eligible item inside authorized scope; do not treat blocked work as done or skip prerequisites. If none exists, yield once with consolidated blockers and next real condition.
dispatch.waiting: Do not create recurring jobs, message other chats, spawn agents or make external changes from this file. A scheduler is separately configured by the user. No waiting loop for learner/reviewer/hardware evidence.
dispatch.parallelism: Default serial. Parallel work is optional only with explicit coordination, satisfied prerequisites and separate source ownership/isolation; shared file writes and evidence gates must remain coordinated.
dispatch.gate_evaluation: Ticket gate_policy_refs are minimum review hints, not an exhaustive whitelist. action_level_gate_policies apply to every matching action, including optional typed feedback and later voice/generation. Unknown required evidence is unsatisfied; do not auto-close or auto-authorize. Exact acceptance remains authoritative.
